title: Stable Names, Stable Disks
description:
Some Guestbook backends need sticky identity — stable DNS names and disks that follow the ordinal, not a random Pod name.

Deploy a StatefulSet with ordered identity and per-pod claims. After a restart, names and volumes should still match.

**Meant for:** StatefulSets + volumeClaimTemplates.

problemStatement.brief: Deploy a StatefulSet with ordered identity and per-pod claims — DNS names and volumes sticky across restarts.
